info.name: MinuNotes Harness API
info.description: Generated from the MinuNotes Harness OpenAPI document. Search and list responses are compact metadata; explicitly read a note, line range, or section when content is needed.

request.description: Run this first. The test script stores the first result id in the noteId collection variable.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.notes?.[0]?.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('noteId', body.notes[0].id);

request.description: Expands the selected compact search result and stores its contentHash for safe edits.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.note?.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('noteId', body.note.id);
const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.contentHash) pm.collectionVariables.set('baseHash', body.contentHash);

request.description: Destination create and read capability required, including credential ceiling and collaboration folder scope. Returns only assigned ID/title summaries; no template library, private storage folder or owner IDs. Note-only grants cannot discover templates.

Destination-scoped assigned Markdown body/defaults and active destination schema. Requires eligible creation and normal agent read/private restrictions. Snapshot covers body/title/defaults/assignment identity, never grants access. Preserve the original four variables only, freezing date/time/datetime literals during review.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.collectionVariables.set('templateSnapshot',body.snapshot); pm.collectionVariables.set('templateSchemaIdJson',JSON.stringify(body.schema.schemaId)); pm.collectionVariables.set('templateSchemaRevision',String(body.schema.revision)); pm.collectionVariables.set('templateTagsJson',JSON.stringify(body.tags)); pm.collectionVariables.set('templateValuesJson',JSON.stringify(body.values)); const now = new Date(), date = now.toLocaleDateString(), time = now.toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}); pm.collectionVariables.set('templateVariablesJson',JSON.stringify({date,time,datetime:date+' '+time})); pm.collectionVariables.set('creationRequestId',pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}')); }

request.description: One atomic/idempotent ordinary Markdown note with complete final tags and property values, including explicit empty clears. Honor reviewed template tags; do not clear them because card chips are hidden or invent tags/fields/options. Destination owner retains ownership; authenticated actor provenance is preserved. Requires create, not source edit permission. Rechecks ACL/assignment/snapshot/schema in the transaction. No client-supplied replacement body. Retry uncertain or busy results with the SAME request ID and exact frozen payload. Completed retries return the original without requiring current defaults; inaccessible/moved/trashed/deleted notes are unavailable and never recreated. Changed payload with the same actor/destination/request key conflicts. 256 KiB body bound; no automatic write retries. On refresh, property-only boards use the folder owner-selected Select property; tags and properties are never synchronized.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.note?.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('noteId', body.note.id);

request.description: Folder-read permission required; direct-note grants do not grant folder access. Missing state is schemaId null, revision 0. Prefer defined properties for structured Status/Type labels; use stable property/option IDs, not labels. Ask when missing; do not invent fields, options or tags.

Owner-only controlled add, rename, reorder or archive. Change definitions only when explicitly requested; ask before inventing fields/options. Server-generated IDs and immutable field types. Existing edit scope and private/read-only-folder policy apply. Reorder includes every historical ID. Retained assignment defaults block archiving referenced fields/choices until explicitly cleared or removed, including templates in Trash. Disable/switch an enabled board before archiving its grouping property. No board configuration endpoint is provided.

Requires note read permission. Only current active fields/values are projected; no resource-owner or containing-folder identifiers. Archived choices remain labeled. Normal Markdown/canvas/mind-map notes only; public shares omit properties.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.collectionVariables.set('propertySchemaId', body.schema.schemaId ?? ''); pm.collectionVariables.set('schemaRevision', String(body.schema.revision)); pm.collectionVariables.set('propertiesRevision', String(body.revision)); const text = body.schema.definitions.find(field => field.type === 'text' && !field.archived); if (text) pm.collectionVariables.set('propertyId', text.id); }

request.description: Requires note edit permission and applicable agent API-editability. Use schemaId, schemaRevision and expectedRevision from a fresh properties read. Supplied active IDs only; null clears and empty Text clears. Archived/foreign IDs cannot be newly assigned. Retained out-of-folder values stay invisible. No-op writes emit no event; changed writes emit properties_update without body/hash/tag/version changes. Property-only UI-configured Select-backed boards regroup on refresh; no board writes or tag synchronization. Select values use stable option IDs from the schema, not labels. Prefer defined properties; do not mirror Status/Type into tags unless requested.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.collectionVariables.set('propertySchemaId', body.schema.schemaId ?? ''); pm.collectionVariables.set('schemaRevision', String(body.schema.revision)); pm.collectionVariables.set('propertiesRevision', String(body.revision)); const text = body.schema.definitions.find(field => field.type === 'text' && !field.archived); if (text) pm.collectionVariables.set('propertyId', text.id); }

request.description: Returns cursor-paginated tags visible in the authorized folder scope.

Replace the complete tag set; omitted tags are removed. Use only explicit/reviewed tags and preserve stored/template tags unless removal is requested. Prefer defined properties for Status/Type; do not invent tags or mirror properties into tags unless requested. Hidden card chips do not authorize clearing tags.
Returns compact owned and explicitly scoped shared-folder metadata. Owner/database and grant identifiers are omitted; inaccessible ancestry and trashed folder subtrees are excluded.

Requires folder-creation permission. Creates an owned folder or a subfolder in an editable explicitly scoped shared folder. Shared resources remain in the owner corpus and are attributed to the authorizing user.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.folder?.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('folderId', body.folder.id);

item.name: Move an eligible folder subtree to Trash

request.description: Destructive. Requires edit capability. Shared-folder Editors may move only a subtree created entirely by the authorizing user, excluding shared roots and owner-managed sharing configuration. Trash restore and permanent deletion remain owner-only.

Searches active owned and explicitly scoped shared notes. Returns compact metadata with privacy-safe role/source context but without note content. Direct-note grants return null folder context. Use the read-note, lines, or section endpoints to expand a selected note.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.notes?.[0]?.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('noteId', body.notes[0].id);

item.name: List notes with no incoming links

request.description: Returns cursor-paginated matching lines and requested context. Cross-note matches omit repeated hashes and size metadata; use the note read endpoint for full content and the current hash.

Create net-new content without reading unrelated notes. For requested structured labels, prefer defined folder properties and stable IDs; ask when missing. Do not invent tags or mirror Status/Type into tags unless requested.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.note?.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('noteId', body.note.id);

request.description: Moves one or more notes to a target folder. Requires edit access to every source folder and create access to the target folder. The response is compact and does not include note content.

Reads an owned or explicitly scoped shared note when its content is needed and returns privacy-safe role/source context. Do not read solely to inspect permissions. Direct-note grants return null folder context. Owner and grant database identifiers are never returned. Not found can also mean inaccessible, revoked, or trashed.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.note?.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('noteId', body.note.id);
const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.contentHash) pm.collectionVariables.set('baseHash', body.contentHash);

request.description: Returns links from the note, including unresolved wikilinks where targetNoteId is null.
Returns notes that link to the target note with wikilinks or internal note URLs. Results are filtered to source notes visible to the current API key.

request.description: Removes only MinuNotes internal-link metadata. External node URLs and other metadata are preserved.

request.description: Lists anchored Review by default. Opt in with includeNoteComments=true for both general discussion and Review with explicit note/text targets. Requires explicit Comment permission and current note read access; direct-note grants do not disclose folder ancestry.

item.name: Create a general discussion or anchored Review thread

request.description: Creates a thread and first message atomically. Use target note without anchor data for general discussion; no document hash or content-edit permission is required. Text-specific Review uses target text and a current exact anchor; legacy body+anchor requests remain valid. Missing/mixed/unknown targets are rejected. Explicit Comment permission and current read access are required for both; never retry mutations automatically.
The note owner or thread author may delete the complete thread.

item.name: Update a locally mapped comment anchor

request.description: Only the original message author may edit it.
Only the original author may delete a message. Deleting the root message deletes its thread.

item.name: Toggle a reaction on a comment message

request.description: Adds the selected reaction for the current actor, or removes it when already present. Requires read and explicit Comment permission.

item.name: Read a publicly shared note and its authored wikilink destinations
Read an attachment owned by a publicly shared note
Read an attachment owned by one note in a publicly shared folder
Read authored wikilink destinations for one note in a publicly shared folder

request.description: The token must be active and the source note must belong to the shared folder subtree. The endpoint accepts no target list and returns no private note metadata.
